offering_description.value: Develops, markets and sells shelf-stable and frozen packaged foods, including vegetables, baking ingredients, spices, snacks and cereals. Sells mainly to grocery chains, mass merchants and foodservice distributors across the United States.

primary_products.value: shelf-stable vegetables; frozen vegetables; baking ingredients; spices and seasonings; snacks; hot cereal

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery chains, mass merchants, club stores, foodservice distributors

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded packaged food sold to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and markets food brands, sold to grocery retailers and distributors; OEM / manufacturer: produces and packages food, partly through co-manufacturers, sold to retailers

geography_served.value: US national: sold across the United States, with some sales in Canada and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: several packaged food lines sharing grocery retail customers and distribution channels

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: grocery chains and mass merchants; distributors / dealers: broadline and foodservice food distributors; online: online grocery and e-commerce retailers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety, labeling and nutrition rules enforced by FDA and USDA
